ability.rpgclasses.ammo_conservation.des: Each bow or crossbow shot has a chance not to consume ammo.
ability.rpgclasses.berserker_rage.desc: For a few seconds you attack faster and harder, but also take more damage. Activating it weakens nearby enemies.
ability.rpgclasses.berserker_rage.name: Berserker Rage
ability.rpgclasses.bloodthirst.desc: Every time you kill an enemy you recover part of your maximum health.
ability.rpgclasses.bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
ability.rpgclasses.bulwark.desc: For a few seconds you greatly reduce all damage you take.
ability.rpgclasses.bulwark.name: Bulwark
ability.rpgclasses.charge.desc: You charge in a straight line and crash into the first enemy: it takes low damage, is knocked back and stunned, and you rebound.
ability.rpgclasses.charge.name: Charge
ability.rpgclasses.charging_bulwark.desc: During Bulwark you run non-stop at great speed, leaving a wind trail, and damage and knock back anything you trample. You smash through weak blocks (leaves, glass, doors, fences and wooden trapdoors...), but each one hurts you a little depending on its hardness.
ability.rpgclasses.charging_bulwark.name: Charging Bulwark
ability.rpgclasses.decoy.desc: When you turn invisible you leave behind a clone with your gear that draws in enemies and runs away.
ability.rpgclasses.decoy.name: Decoy
ability.rpgclasses.deflect.desc: Automatic, with a cooldown. Reduces a projectile's damage by an amount equal to your Total Level. If you reduce it to zero, you send it back. Grants charges: +1 in Fire, +3 in Water and +1 in Stone.
ability.rpgclasses.deflect.name: Projectile Deflection
ability.rpgclasses.double_jump.desc: Press jump again in mid-air to perform a second jump.
ability.rpgclasses.double_jump.name: Double Jump
ability.rpgclasses.free_cast_slot_1.desc: Choose a spell (select it on the wheel and use /clase conjuro 1) that stays bound to this slot for good. While you have charges, casting it costs a charge instead of mana.
ability.rpgclasses.free_cast_slot_1.name: Free Cast I
ability.rpgclasses.free_cast_slot_2.desc: Second free-cast slot, with more charges and a higher cost limit.
ability.rpgclasses.free_cast_slot_2.name: Free Cast II
ability.rpgclasses.free_cast_slot_3.desc: Third free-cast slot, with the highest allowed cost.
ability.rpgclasses.free_cast_slot_3.name: Free Cast III
ability.rpgclasses.healing_bulwark.desc: While Bulwark is active, part of the damage you mitigate heals nearby allies and yourself.
ability.rpgclasses.healing_bulwark.name: Healing Bulwark
ability.rpgclasses.heavy_shot.desc: Holding the bow fully drawn increases shot damage in time steps.
ability.rpgclasses.heavy_shot.name: Heavy Shot
ability.rpgclasses.incorruptible_bulwark: Bulwark removes all your negative effects and makes you immune to new ones while it lasts.
ability.rpgclasses.lethal_shot.desc: Upgrades Heavy Shot: the steps come sooner and the last one is much stronger.
ability.rpgclasses.lethal_shot.name: Lethal Shot
ability.rpgclasses.light_step.desc: You take no fall damage and walk on water. In Fire Stance you also walk on lava.
ability.rpgclasses.light_step.name: Light Step
ability.rpgclasses.shadow_step.desc: You teleport behind the enemy you are looking at (up to 10 blocks). For 8 s your hits against that enemy are guaranteed critical hits and, if you kill it in that time, the ability recharges instantly.
ability.rpgclasses.shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
ability.rpgclasses.stances.desc: Each press switches to the next stance (Water, Stone, Fire). You only build charges of the active stance: Fire with every unarmed hit (more damage), Stone when taking hits (more armor) and Water when running, dodging or deflecting (more speed and jump). At maximum, or with Shift + hit (or crouch + this key) from 10 charges, your next unarmed hit spends them all: Fiery Strike, stun or Countercurrent. Switching stance releases the previous stance's charges as an area effect. Charges fade gradually when you stop gaining them and when you put on armor.
ability.rpgclasses.stances.name: Elemental Stances
ability.rpgclasses.steady_guard.desc: You deal more damage to enemies that are targeting you.
ability.rpgclasses.steady_guard.name: Steady Guard
ability.rpgclasses.stealth.desc: When you crouch you become truly invisible while you have Stealth bar left. Attacking or casting a spell uses up a large part of the bar.
ability.rpgclasses.stealth.name: Stealth
ability.rpgclasses.taunt.desc: Forces nearby mobs to attack you, slows them and reduces the damage you take for a few seconds.
ability.rpgclasses.taunt.name: Taunt
ability.rpgclasses.triple_jump.desc: Adds a third jump in mid-air.
ability.rpgclasses.triple_jump.name: Triple Jump
ability.rpgclasses.wall_climb.desc: Crouching next to a wall you cling to it and can climb it. If you draw a bow, you let go.
ability.rpgclasses.wall_climb.name: Wall Climb
ability.rpgclasses.wind_dash.desc: A horizontal burst in mid-air, with charges that recover on their own.
ability.rpgclasses.wind_dash.name: Wind Dash
branch.rpgclasses.barbarian.brutality.de: Your critical hits deal much more damage.
branch.rpgclasses.barbarian.fury.desc: Wound Fury: you deal more damage the more health you are missing.
branch.rpgclasses.barbarian.fury.name: Fury
branch.rpgclasses.barbarian.hardened.des: You take less damage from falls, fire and explosions, and lose less hunger.
branch.rpgclasses.barbarian.iron_skin.de: With no armor on, you gain armor, toughness and movement speed.
branch.rpgclasses.barbarian.stampede.des: Charge reaches farther and recharges sooner. Dormant until you have Charge.
branch.rpgclasses.mage.cadence.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your spells.
branch.rpgclasses.mage.cadence.name: Cadence
branch.rpgclasses.mage.fluidity.desc: You move faster; with the branch full, casting spells does not slow you down.
branch.rpgclasses.mage.fluidity.name: Fluidity
branch.rpgclasses.mage.power.desc: Increases the power of all your spells.
branch.rpgclasses.mage.power.name: Power
branch.rpgclasses.mage.reserve.desc: Increases your maximum mana and how fast you recover it (+40% mana per second at 10 points). Iron's regenerates based on maximum mana, so the regeneration attribute is lowered to compensate.
branch.rpgclasses.mage.reserve.name: Reserve
branch.rpgclasses.mage.summoning.desc: Your summons have more health and deal more damage.
branch.rpgclasses.mage.summoning.name: Summoning
branch.rpgclasses.monk.fist.desc: Empowers Fire charges: more damage per charge and a stronger discharge wave.
branch.rpgclasses.monk.fist.name: Fist
branch.rpgclasses.monk.meditation.desc: Crouching and standing still for a few seconds, you slowly heal up to a health limit. Taking damage interrupts it. When you stop meditating you gain 4 charges of your stance that do not decay for 10 s.
branch.rpgclasses.monk.meditation.name: Meditation
branch.rpgclasses.monk.skin.desc: Empowers Stone charges: more armor and toughness per charge and more absorption on discharge.
branch.rpgclasses.monk.skin.name: Skin
branch.rpgclasses.monk.stance_mastery.de: Your discharges when switching stance and your own stance effects are stronger: +20% at 5 points and +40% at 10 (maximum charges remain 10).
branch.rpgclasses.monk.wind.desc: Empowers Water charges: more speed and jump per charge and a stronger discharge.
branch.rpgclasses.monk.wind.name: Wind
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.banner.desc: An aura around you: you and your allies gain armor and negative effects last shorter on you. Does not stack with another Paladin's.
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.banner.name: Banner
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.cuirass.desc: Multiplies the armor and toughness granted by the pieces you are wearing.
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.cuirass.name: Cuirass
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.push.desc: You get pushed less and you push enemies more.
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.push.name: Push
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.smite.desc: More damage against undead and Nether mobs, and slightly more damage overall if you carry no shield.
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.smite.name: Smite
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.will.desc: Negative effects last shorter on you.
branch.rpgclasses.paladin.will.name: Will
branch.rpgclasses.ranger.aim.desc: More damage with bows and crossbows, and zoom when crouching with the bow in hand or while drawing it.
branch.rpgclasses.ranger.aim.name: Aim
branch.rpgclasses.ranger.cadence.name: Cadence
branch.rpgclasses.ranger.range.desc: Your projectiles fly faster and travel farther. Does not increase damage.
branch.rpgclasses.ranger.range.name: Range
branch.rpgclasses.ranger.retreat.desc: With the branch full, after taking a melee hit you run faster for a few seconds.
branch.rpgclasses.ranger.retreat.name: Retreat
The effects of your potion arrows last longer and are stronger.
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.acrobatics.desc: Epic Fight's dodge uses less stamina and its invulnerability lasts longer.
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.edge.desc: You attack faster and your critical hits deal more damage.
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.edge.name: Edge
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.shadow.desc: Mobs detect you from closer, and your critical hits from invisibility deal more damage.
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.shadow.name: Shadow
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.toxins.desc: Your hits can poison with Toxin, a slow damage that does not stack.
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.toxins.name: Toxins
branch.rpgclasses.rogue.wind.name: Wind
class.rpgclasses.barbarian.desc: An unarmored warrior with heavy weapons. The less health he has, the more damage he deals, and his critical hits are the strongest. Wearing any piece of armor switches off his natural defense, except Barbarian harnesses (his class gear).
class.rpgclasses.barbarian.name: Barbarian
class.rpgclasses.mage.desc: Spellcaster using Iron's Spells. Lots of ranged damage and utility in exchange for very little toughness. Its branches increase spell power, mana and cooldown speed.
class.rpgclasses.mage.name: Mage
class.rpgclasses.monk.desc: An unarmed, unarmored fighter. Their level gives a base of damage and defense; the rest is earned in combat by building Fire, Stone or Water charges. Wearing armor switches off their passives and wipes the charges, except Monk robes (their class gear). Nunchaku, sai, bo and knuckles count as unarmed.
class.rpgclasses.monk.name: Monk
class.rpgclasses.monk.trait: Martial Body: no armor (Monk robes do not count), unarmed damage, armor and toughness that grow with your base class points (full at 30). Fire subtracts 25% from this armor and Water 25% from this damage.
class.rpgclasses.paladin.desc: The group's tank. Withstands more than anyone with armor and shield, draws enemies in and protects allies. Deals little damage on his own.
class.rpgclasses.paladin.name: Paladin
class.rpgclasses.paladin.trait: Class trait: more maximum health and slightly less speed.
class.rpgclasses.ranger.desc: Bow marksman. Steady ranged damage, fast long-range arrows and good mobility. Can wear armor without penalty.
class.rpgclasses.ranger.name: Ranger
class.rpgclasses.rogue.desc: An agile assassin with light weapons. Turns invisible, strikes by surprise with guaranteed critical hits and moves very fast. Very fragile if caught.
class.rpgclasses.rogue.name: Rogue
curio.rpgclasses.arcane_hourglass.desc: When you drop below 30% health, projectiles within 6 blocks slow down (60 s).
curio.rpgclasses.archmage_prism.desc: Every 5th damaging spell refracts: 30% of it jumps to another nearby enemy.
curio.rpgclasses.crow_cloak.desc: When you leave invisibility, a flock of crows blinds enemies within 3 blocks for 1 s (15 s).
curio.rpgclasses.cyclops_horn.desc: When you enter combat the horn sounds: enemies within 16 blocks glow for 8 s and your allies gain Strength for 8 s (90 s).
curio.rpgclasses.dragonslayer_quiver.des: Every 11th arrow is a dragon bone arrow: +50% damage and pierces one enemy.
curio.rpgclasses.evergreen_leaf.desc: Inside leaves you regenerate health and mobs farther than 8 blocks do not target you.
curio.rpgclasses.fang_collar.desc: Each hostile mob you kill adds a fang (max 10, lost on death): +1% melee damage per fang.
curio.rpgclasses.frost_ring.desc: You freeze water as you walk on it.
curio.rpgclasses.gorgon_eye.desc: Staring for 2 s at a non-boss mob petrifies it for 2 s (30 s).
curio.rpgclasses.guild_insignia.desc: When you switch to a weapon of another discipline, +10% melee damage for 3 s (6 s).
curio.rpgclasses.hermit_medallion.desc: Attracts items and experience orbs within 6 blocks.
curio.rpgclasses.hippogryph_feather.desc: Drawing a bow in mid-air makes you glide.
curio.rpgclasses.last_breath_compass.des: When you die, a column of light marks the place where you fell for 10 min.
curio.rpgclasses.loaded_dice.desc: Each critical hit rolls a die: on a 6 it deals an extra ×1.5; on a 1 it becomes a normal hit.
curio.rpgclasses.magma_heart.desc: When you take a melee hit, 15% chance to set the attacker on fire. You leave glowing footprints.
curio.rpgclasses.midnight_veil.desc: The sun deals half damage to you.
curio.rpgclasses.oath_reliquary.desc: Whoever hits a mob that is chasing you (you or your allies) heals 1 HP (once per second).
curio.rpgclasses.phoenix_feather.desc: A lethal hit makes you be reborn in flames with 30% health (20 min). Resolves after class and race abilities.
curio.rpgclasses.pixie_bell.desc: Crouching in mid-air, you float for 3 s (10 s cooldown).
curio.rpgclasses.pocket_banner.desc: You carry a golden banner on your back.
curio.rpgclasses.relic_rule: You can only wear one Relic at a time.
curio.rpgclasses.serpent_pendant.desc: You swim faster and, when leaving the water, run faster for 5 s.
curio.rpgclasses.stance_rosary.desc: When switching stance with 8 or more charges, the beads bounce between 3 enemies.
curio.rpgclasses.storm_talisman.desc: When you take a melee hit, 10% chance for lightning to strike the attacker (8 s).
curio.rpgclasses.temple_bell.desc: When you finish meditating, your allies within 8 blocks lose one negative effect.
curio.rpgclasses.tide_conch.desc: Underwater, your allies within 5 blocks recover air. On land, if you are burning, it puts the fire out (10 s).
curio.rpgclasses.traveler_belt.desc: Below 6 hunger shanks you eat only food from your inventory (no effects).
curio.rpgclasses.trinket_pouch.desc: 5% chance to duplicate a common drop on kill.
curio.rpgclasses.troll_earring.desc: When your Last Stand activates, mobs within 6 blocks flee.
curio.rpgclasses.trophy_skull.desc: When you kill a boss, the skull keeps its trophy and grants you a trait of that boss until the next one (fire immunity, slowness immunity, wither immunity... or +10% damage).
curio.rpgclasses.trophy_skull.taken: The skull holds the trophy of %s
curio.rpgclasses.war_drum.desc: Berserker Rage sounds the drums: your allies within 10 blocks attack faster for 10 s.
curio.rpgclasses.wisp_lantern.desc: Every 30 s, a will-o'-the-wisp flies toward the nearest chest or spawner within 24 blocks.
death.attack.rpgclasses.arrow_blast: %1$s was blown sky-high by an arrow from %2$s
death.attack.rpgclasses.arrow_blast.play: %1$s was blown sky-high by an arrow from %2$s
death.attack.rpgclasses.dragon_spark: %1$s was struck down by %2$s's dragon lightning
death.attack.rpgclasses.dragon_spark.pla: %1$s was struck down by %2$s's dragon lightning
death.attack.rpgclasses.toxin.player: %1$s died poisoned by a toxin while fleeing from %2$s

gear.rpgclasses.element.fire: Fire scales: each piece reduces fire damage.
gear.rpgclasses.element.ice: Ice scales: each piece reduces ice damage.
gear.rpgclasses.element.lightning: Lightning scales: each piece reduces lightning damage.
gear.rpgclasses.exempt.barbarian: Does not disable the Barbarian's unarmed passives.
gear.rpgclasses.exempt.monk: Does not disable Martial Body or wipe the Monk's charges.
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_chain.desc: War Rattle: the first hit after 2 s of running knocks back harder.
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_chain.name: Ringed Chain Harness
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_diamond.de: Crunch: your critical hits slow the target for 1 s (once every 3 s per target).
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_dragon.des: Dragon's Roar: Berserker Rage lets out a roar; non-boss mobs within 8 blocks flee and suffer the scales' element.
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_dragonstee: Wyrm's Wrath: below 40% health or during Berserker Rage you sprout spectral wings and each critical hit releases a 4-block elemental cone (once per second).
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_gold.desc: Golden Loot: when you kill a hostile mob, 10% chance it drops a gold nugget that leaps toward you.
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_gold.name: Plunderer's Finery
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_iron.name: Iron Harness
gear.rpgclasses.set.barbarian_leather.de: Scent: hostile mobs within 12 blocks with less than 30% health glow.
Ember Heart: each hit you take builds an ember (max 5, 8 s). Charge or Berserker Rage releases them in a 4-block ring of fire.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_chain.desc: Ringing Links: each charge chimes and, on reaching the threshold, the links ring in chord.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_chain.name: Ringed Gi
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_diamond.desc: Crystal Reflection: Projectile Deflection grants +1 charge with a prismatic flash.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_diamond.name: Crystal Habit
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_dragon.desc: Dragon Dance: when you trigger a stance effect, a spectral dragon in the stance's color circles you for 4 s and bites the nearest enemy every second.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_dragon.name: Scaled Mantle
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_dragonsteel.des: Wyrm Fist: each stance effect launches an energy dragon head that travels 8 blocks in a line. Fire: walking on lava in Fire Stance grants speed. Ice: in Water you freeze water as you walk. Lightning: in Stone, heavy hits you take release a spark.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_gold.name: Pilgrim's Tunic
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_iron.desc: Firm Stance: Stone gains charge from hits as low as 1.5 HP.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_iron.name: Iron Gi
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_leather.desc: First Step: when entering a stance with no charges you receive 1, and charges decay 10% slower.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_leather.name: Novice's Wraps
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_netherite.desc: Stance Seal: Stone charges decay half as fast and, when switching stance with 5 or more charges, you leave a runic seal that repeats the discharge at 30% after 3 s.
gear.rpgclasses.set.monk_netherite.name: Obsidian Kesa
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.desc: Slow, with extra reach and an arc sweep that hits other enemies for 60%.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.late1: Ashen Sweep: the sweep blinds mobs for 1 s.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.late2: Pole Vault: crouch + jump launches you forward and you land with a shockwave (8 s).
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.bo.late3: Horizon Wave: if you wait 1.5 s between hits, the hit sends out an elemental wave in an arc.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.element.lightning: Lightning: each hit jumps to a nearby enemy.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.desc: Worn in the Curios hands slot (or in the off hand), they improve empty-handed strikes.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.late1: Obsidian Fists: on the 5th hit against the same target, a 2-block burst.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.late2: Dragon Claws: your hits can inflict Wound (−30% healing for 4 s).
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.knuckles.late3: Wyrm Fists: your hits apply the element and the Monk's stance effects are 20% stronger.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.monk: Monk: counts as unarmed (charges, perks and subclass).
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.desc: Fast, with short reach. For the Monk it counts as unarmed.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.late1: Whirl: every 8 chained hits, a spin that strikes all around for 50%.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.late2: Bone Echo: the Whirl leaves a ghost nunchaku that repeats 3 hits at 30%.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.nunchaku.late3: Chain Storm: the Whirl becomes a 3 s whirlwind that pulls enemies in and applies the element.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.desc: Medium speed. Hold right click to guard: a hit in the first instants is parried and stuns the attacker; otherwise it reduces damage.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.late1: Iron Parry: the parry returns 50% of the hit.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.late2: Disarm: the parry gives the attacker Weakness II for 3 s.
gear.rpgclasses.weapon.sai.late3: Wyrm Counter: after a parry, your next hit within 1.5 s is an elemental thrust that pierces in a line.

Underwater, immune to Mining Fatigue, Blindness and Darkness.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_acid_stomach.de: Immune to the Hunger effect and to the negative effects of food.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_adaptable.desc: Reduces the chosen wall and the negative base traits of your class.

The anvil costs you fewer levels.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_aquatic.desc: You mine underwater at normal speed and see underwater. Fire hurts you more.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_aquatic.name: Water Creature
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_arcane.desc: Improved enchanting table and Arcane Fusion.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_arcane.name: Arcane Lore
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_area_break.desc: You break blocks in a cube (one at a time while sneaking). Never containers.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_area_break.name: Giant Hands
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_auto_smelt.desc: Ores you mine come out smelted.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_auto_smelt.name: Smelting Touch
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_barter.desc: Chance for bartering with piglins to give double.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_barter.name: Infernal Deal
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_belt.desc: Utility blocks you carry on you, and allied passengers.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_belt.name: Belt
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_blast_proof.des: Explosions you cause do not hurt you.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_blessed.desc: You receive more healing from potions and spells.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_blessed.name: Blessed
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_bones.desc: Neutral skeletons and less projectile damage.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_bones.name: Bones
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_bouncy.desc: No fall damage; you bounce when landing on any block (sneaking prevents it).
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_bouncy.name: Elastic Body
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_breath.desc: Channelled cone of your element (racial key 1). Costs mana and suffers the Magic wall.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_breath.name: Breath
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_breath_acid.des: Your breath applies Corrosion: less armor and toughness.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_breath_fire.des: Your breath sets the target on fire.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_breath_ice.name: Ice Breath
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_breath_lightnin: The lightning of your breath jumps to nearby enemies.

perk.rpgclasses.rogue.toxins.concentrate: Toxin deals the same damage, but much faster.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.toxins.prolonged_d: Toxin deals the same damage, more slowly, and slows the target while it lasts.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.wind.evasion.desc: Chance to dodge hits and projectiles by leaping backward. Less maximum health.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.wind.evasion.name: Evasion
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.wind.lightness.des: More movement and attack speed, but Stealth runs out sooner.
race.rpgclasses.centaur.desc: Horse body: accelerates gradually when running in a straight line and, above 40% of its top speed, rams whatever it hits (losing speed when it does). Charged jump like a horse (hold jump) and an ally can ride on its back. Does not fit through 1-block gaps and cannot ride animals or boats.
race.rpgclasses.centaur.name: Centaur
race.rpgclasses.colossus.desc: Twice the size and twice the health (no cap). Breaks blocks in a 2×2×2 cube (one at a time while sneaking), and its reach, step, jump and safe fall grow with its size. In exchange: more hunger, cannot swim (sinks), mobs detect it from farther away, tramples crops and cannot ride animals or boats.
race.rpgclasses.colossus.name: Colossus
race.rpgclasses.draconid.desc: Descendant of dragons: resists damage from its element and breathes a breath of that element (racial key 1), which costs mana and suffers your class's Magic wall. Wild dragons of its element (Ice and Fire) do not attack it unless provoked. Uses more hunger.
race.rpgclasses.draconid.name: Draconid
race.rpgclasses.dwarf.desc: Short and slow, but a born miner: breaks stone and ores faster and has racial Fortune on ores (it doesn't add to the enchantment: the higher one counts).
race.rpgclasses.dwarf.name: Dwarf
race.rpgclasses.elf.desc: Passes through leaves and climbs them like scaffolding (jumping goes up, crouching goes down). Cannot eat meat or fish.
race.rpgclasses.elf.name: Elf
race.rpgclasses.goblin.desc: Half the height: very hard to hit and fits through small gaps. Has racial Luck and Looting (the higher of this and the enchantment counts). In return, much less health.
race.rpgclasses.goblin.name: Goblin
race.rpgclasses.human.desc: Versatile: eases the drawbacks of their class. After choosing a class they pick a wall, whose penalty is reduced according to Rank; the class's negative base traits are reduced the same way. No environmental perks.
race.rpgclasses.human.name: Human
race.rpgclasses.infernal.desc: Immune to fire and lava, but cold and water hurt more and entering water slowly burns them. With Iron's Spells they have racial fire spells always available, which suffer your class's Magic wall like any spell. Iron golems always attack them and villagers charge them more.
race.rpgclasses.infernal.name: Infernal
race.rpgclasses.orc.desc: Bigger and tougher. Once per life they survive a lethal hit with half a heart. In return they use more hunger and are easier to hit.
race.rpgclasses.orc.name: Orc
race.rpgclasses.slime.desc: Takes no fall damage, bounces when landing on any block (sneaking prevents it) and jumps twice as high. In exchange, less health and it gets knocked back farther.
race.rpgclasses.slime.name: Slime
race.rpgclasses.triton.desc: Breathes underwater, swims faster, mines underwater at normal speed and sees in the dark underwater. Fire hurts more and in the Nether they have Weakness.
race.rpgclasses.triton.name: Triton
race.rpgclasses.undead.desc: Breathes underwater, their hunger is fixed and they constantly regenerate health (interrupted for a few seconds when taking damage). Direct sunlight damages them even with a helmet, and neither healing potions nor spells heal them.
race.rpgclasses.undead.name: Undead
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.pegasus.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies with your ram and make 20 slow falls from at least 8 blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.pegasus.2.desc: Offer 64 feathers, 16 phantom membranes and 8 firework rockets.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.pegasus.3.desc: With the altar at height 150 or higher, defeat a rite boss gliding at least 3 times during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.pegasus.3.o0: Boss defeated up high with 3 glides
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.unicorn.2.desc: Offer 4 golden apples, 8 amethyst shards, 16 gold ingots and 8 flowers of at least 4 kinds.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.unicorn.2.o0: Golden apples, amethyst, gold and flowers
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.unicorn.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss with at least 2 allies inside your aura, dealing at least 40% of the damage with your ram.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.unicorn.3.o0: Boss defeated with allies in the aura
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.warrior.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with melee attacks at no less than 40% of your top speed.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.warrior.2.desc: Offer a full set of iron armor, 1 iron weapon, 8 leather and 16 iron ingots.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.warrior.2.o0: Iron armor and weapon, leather and iron
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.warrior.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss chaining at least 10 melee hits without dropping below 40% of your speed.
rite.rpgclasses.centaur.warrior.3.o0: Boss defeated with 10 hits at a gallop
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.porter.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with at least 3 belt slots filled.
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.porter.1.o0: Enemies defeated with a loaded belt
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.porter.2.desc: Offer 4 chests, 2 furnaces, 1 crafting table, 16 leather and 16 iron ingots.
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.porter.2.o0: Chests, furnaces, table, leather and iron
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.porter.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss with an ally riding on you who deals at least 25% of the damage.
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.titan.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies and break 200 blocks with area breaking (standing).
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.titan.2.desc: Offer 4 iron blocks, 8 obsidian, 64 cobblestone and 1 anvil.
rite.rpgclasses.colossus.titan.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss with the Titan form active and deal at least 50% of the damage in that form.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.acid.1.desc: Defeat 30 armored enemies corroded by your breath.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.acid.2.desc: Offer 4 potions of Harming, 16 spider eyes and 16 slimeballs.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.acid.2.o0: Harming potions, spider eyes and slime
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.acid.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss applying Corrosion to it at least 5 times.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.fire.2.desc: Offer 8 blaze rods, 16 charcoal and 4 lava buckets.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.fire.3.desc: With the altar in the Nether, defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.ice.2.desc: Offer 64 snow blocks, 16 packed ice and 4 blue ice.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.ice.3.desc: With the altar in a snowy or frozen biome, defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.lightning.1.des: Defeat 30 enemies with your breath (lightning jumps count).
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.lightning.2.des: Offer 4 lightning rods, 32 copper ingots and 16 redstone.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.lightning.3.des: Summon a rite boss during a thunderstorm, with the altar under open sky, and defeat it dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.poison.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies poisoned by your breath (undead do not count).
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.poison.2.desc: Offer 16 spider eyes, 4 potions of Poison, 8 poisonous potatoes and 4 pufferfish.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.poison.2.o0: Spider eyes, poison, potatoes and pufferfish
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.poison.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss poisoning it with your breath at least 5 times.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.water.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with your breath, 10 of them while you are submerged.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.water.1.o1: Defeated with the breath while submerged
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.water.2.desc: Offer 16 fish of at least 3 kinds, 32 kelp and 8 potions of Water Breathing.
rite.rpgclasses.draconid.water.3.desc: With the altar underwater (at least 3 blocks deep), defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.2.desc: Offer 64 ores of at least 3 types.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar underground.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies with your own explosions.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.2.desc: Craft and offer 16 TNT (crafted while doing this rite).
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss that takes at least 4 of your explosions.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with a weapon you crafted.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.2.desc: Offer an iron armor set and an iron weapon crafted by you.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.2.o0: Iron armor and weapon made by you
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss while wearing all 4 diamond (or netherite) armor pieces crafted by you.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.3.o0: Boss defeated in your diamond armor
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with a weapon you enchanted at the table.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.1.o0: Enemies defeated with your enchanted weapon
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.2.desc: Enchant 3 items at the table and offer them.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.3.desc: Offer 2 books with the same enchantment at its maximum level.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.dark.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies in light level 7 or less.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.dark.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss at night, using Smoke Cloud at least 3 times during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.dark.3.o0: Boss defeated at night with 3 Clouds
rite.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.2.desc: Offer 16 each of 4 different crops (64 in total).
rite.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar in a forest biome.
rite.rpgclasses.fail.ability: too few uses of the ability
rite.rpgclasses.fail.boss_hits: too few hits taken from the boss
rite.rpgclasses.fail.counts: you did not complete the rite's actions during the fight
rite.rpgclasses.fail.crafted_diamond: you were not wearing your diamond armor
rite.rpgclasses.fail.mounted: you dismounted the wolf or it died
rite.rpgclasses.fail.racial_share: too little damage with racial spells
rite.rpgclasses.fail.source_share: too little damage with your racial trait
rite.rpgclasses.fail.wall_share: too little damage with your wall's discipline
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.2.desc: Offer 64 mob loot items of at least 8 types.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.3.desc: Offer 3 pieces of mob gear (stolen or dropped by mobs you killed) and defeat a rite boss.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies caught by your Snare.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss immobilized by your Snare at least 3 times.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.wolf_rider.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss mounted on your wolf for the whole fight without it dying.
rite.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.1.desc: Defeat 6 enemies of each of 5 different mob types.
rite.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.2.desc: Surround the altar with 15 bookshelves (like an enchanting table: 2 blocks away, at its height or one higher) and offer 10 books.
rite.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.3.desc: Offer a book enchanted with an enchantment at its maximum level, a level II potion and a map explored almost completely (90%).
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.1.desc: Defeat 10 enemies with each of 3 different combat styles (magic, bow, heavy weapons, light weapons or unarmed).
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.2.desc: Offer on the altar one item of each category: heavy weapon, light weapon, bow or crossbow, shield, armor piece and a spell scroll or book.
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.3.desc: Summon a rite boss at the altar and defeat it using the disciplines of your two chosen walls, with at least 25% of the damage in each (Armor: wear 3+ pieces; Shields: block 10 hits).
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.3.o0: Boss defeated with your two walls
rite.rpgclasses.human.specialist.1.desc: Defeat 40 enemies with the discipline of your chosen wall.
rite.rpgclasses.human.specialist.2.desc: Offer on the altar a high-quality item (diamond or better, or enchanted if it has no tier) of your wall's discipline.
rite.rpgclasses.human.specialist.3.desc: Summon a rite boss and defeat it dealing at least 90% of the damage with your wall's discipline.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.native.1.desc: Defeat 30 hostile Nether mobs (piglins and hoglins don't count).
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.native.2.desc: Barter 20 times with piglins and offer 16 Nether quartz.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.native.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar in the Nether.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.1.de: Defeat 40 enemies with your racial spells.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.2.de: Offer 8 fire charges, 4 magma blocks and 8 blaze rods.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.3.de: Defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with racial spells.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies while standing on lava.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.2.desc: Offer 64 ingots of at least 3 types.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar within 4 blocks of lava.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.2.desc: Offer 16 cooked meats of at least 3 types.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss and offer one of its drops on the altar.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.2.desc: Offer 4 obsidian, 16 iron ingots and 1 anvil.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss after taking at least 10 of its hits without dying.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.3.o0: Boss defeated after 10 of its hits
rite.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.1.desc: Defeat 40 enemies with an ally (player or pet) within 12 blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.2.desc: Build a camp next to the altar (6 blocks): 1 campfire, 4 banners and 2 beds.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss with at least 2 allies (players or pets) within 12 blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.place.deep_water: under at least 3 blocks of water
rite.rpgclasses.place.snowy: in a snowy or frozen biome
rite.rpgclasses.place.storm: under open sky during a thunderstorm
rite.rpgclasses.slime.mitotic.1.desc: Split (from an enemy's hit) and merge back with your copy 2 times.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.mitotic.2.desc: Offer 2 identical items of each of 6 different kinds of iron quality or better.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.mitotic.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss after splitting during the fight, and merge with your living copy at the end.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.mitotic.3.o0: Boss defeated after splitting and merging
rite.rpgclasses.slime.spring.1.desc: Make 40 launches with at least 2 s of charge and defeat 15 enemies with the crash of a launch.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.spring.2.desc: Offer 8 pistons, 4 sticky pistons, 16 slimeballs and 4 slime blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.spring.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss hitting it with at least 3 launch crashes during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.swarm.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with the contact of your small slimes.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.swarm.2.desc: Offer 32 slimeballs, 4 slime blocks and 3 potions of Healing.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.swarm.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss while split, with at least 6 slimes alive at the end and at least 50% of the damage by contact.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.viscous.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies while stuck to a wall or an entity.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.viscous.2.desc: Offer 8 honey blocks, 16 honey bottles, 16 slimeballs and 8 cobwebs.
rite.rpgclasses.slime.viscous.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss having been stuck to it for at least 10 s in total and with at least 20 hits that apply Slowness.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.2.desc: With the altar underwater, offer 16 prismarine crystals, 8 sea lanterns and 3 nautilus shells.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.3.desc: Defeat an elder guardian, or a rite boss summoned with the altar underwater.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.2.desc: Offer 32 fish of 4 types and an enchanted fishing rod.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.3.desc: Offer a treasure item you fished up and defeat a rite boss.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies that are in water.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.2.desc: Offer 4 sponges, 8 coral blocks and 3 water buckets.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss using Wave or Water Wall at least 3 times.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.3.o0: Boss defeated with 3 waves or walls
rite.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.1.desc: Take 50 projectile hits and defeat 20 enemies (skeletons don't count).
rite.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.2.desc: Offer 64 bones, 32 arrows and 4 bone blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss after taking at least 10 projectiles from it or its escort without dying.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.specter.1.desc: Defeat 20 flying mobs (phantoms, vexes, blazes, ghasts…).
rite.rpgclasses.undead.specter.2.desc: Offer 16 phantom membranes, 16 feathers and 4 ender pearls.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.specter.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss using Ethereal Form at least 3 times during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.1.desc: Defeat 30 hostile mobs at night or in light level 7 or less.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.2.desc: Offer 16 redstone dust, 8 beetroots and 8 red mushrooms.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss recovering at least 100 HP with Thirst during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.3.o0: Boss defeated healing 100 HP with Thirst
subclass.rpgclasses.agile_scout.desc: Swift scout: more speed, triple jump and wall climbing.
subclass.rpgclasses.agile_scout.name: Agile Scout
subclass.rpgclasses.arcane_blade.desc: A Rogue who also casts spells: loses the Magic wall, gains mana and power, and their first spell from invisibility hits harder.
subclass.rpgclasses.arcane_blade.name: Arcane Blade
subclass.rpgclasses.battle_mage.desc: A front-line Mage who alternates sword and spell. Each spell imbues your weapon with its school (fire burns, ice slows, lightning jumps, blood heals, nature poisons, ender takes you behind the target, evocation raises fangs, eldritch releases a sonic wave in a line and water pushes); every 3 consecutive hits your next spell costs less mana. You aren't interrupted when casting, you lose the melee weapon walls and the mana you spend gives you a shield.
subclass.rpgclasses.battle_mage.name: Battle Mage
subclass.rpgclasses.beast_master.desc: Your bonded pets are stronger, faster and tougher, and escape death by returning to your spawn point, where they lose their non-permanent potion effects, are extinguished if burning and are invulnerable for 5 s. Bonds are made and broken only with the Book of Bonds.
subclass.rpgclasses.beast_master.name: Beast Master
subclass.rpgclasses.blessed_guardian.des: Healing protector. You receive more healing and your Bulwark heals the group with the damage you mitigate.
subclass.rpgclasses.breeze_master.desc: The fastest and the highest jumper, with an aerial dash.
subclass.rpgclasses.breeze_master.name: Breeze Master
subclass.rpgclasses.chaotic_evoker.desc: Bigger, more unpredictable spells: their damage varies at random and, when casting, a chaotic effect sometimes triggers (almost always good): turning into a chicken and flying, huge speed or jump, a second spell, meteors, lightning, swapping positions... and now and then something bad.
subclass.rpgclasses.chaotic_evoker.name: Chaotic Evoker
A mountain of health. Your Bulwark becomes an unstoppable charge that tramples enemies.
subclass.rpgclasses.elementalist.desc: Your spells build charges on enemies; when full they detonate according to the school: fire explodes, ice freezes, lightning jumps in arcs, blood steals life, ender teleports, evocation raises fangs, nature roots and poisons, eldritch leaves the Mark of the Void (stores the damage it takes and then implodes), and water (with T.O Magic 'n Extras) launches a wave that pushes and soaks.
subclass.rpgclasses.elementalist.name: Elementalist
subclass.rpgclasses.heavy_palm.desc: Hits that knock back and reach farther. While crouching you charge the palm (more damage and knockback; at full charge it breaks guard). If the launched enemy crashes into a block or another enemy, it takes extra damage and is stunned and disabled.
subclass.rpgclasses.heavy_palm.name: Heavy Palm
subclass.rpgclasses.indestructible.desc: More health and the Gamble with Death: on a fatal hit a coin is flipped; on the ankh you survive (75% the first time, then 50%).
subclass.rpgclasses.indestructible.name: Indestructible
subclass.rpgclasses.plague_corruptor.des: Immune to hunger, poison and wither. Your hits spread the Plague, which damages over time even the undead.
subclass.rpgclasses.shadow_illusionist.d: Even harder to detect, and when you turn invisible you leave a decoy that distracts enemies.
subclass.rpgclasses.shadow_walker.desc: You move crouched as fast as walking and teleport short distances.
subclass.rpgclasses.shadow_walker.name: Shadow Walker
subclass.rpgclasses.sniper.desc: Very fast arrows and much more damage per shot, in exchange for drawing the bow slower.
subclass.rpgclasses.sniper.name: Sniper
subclass.rpgclasses.suicidal_berserker.d: More damage, and when you take a fatal hit you become immortal for a few seconds: if you kill your attacker, you live.
subclass.rpgclasses.triworld_guardian.de: Each stance protects you from one type of damage and adds its own effect: fire, water or stone.
subclass.rpgclasses.unyielding_bastion.d: Immovable. Immune to knockback, you resist bursts of hits and your Bulwark cleanses you of negative effects.
subrace.rpgclasses.centaur.pegasus.desc: When falling from high up you glide slowly and without damage; with ranks, from lower heights, with air control and a wing flap.
subrace.rpgclasses.centaur.pegasus.name: Pegasus
subrace.rpgclasses.centaur.unicorn.desc: Nearby allies regenerate mana faster, you receive more healing from potions and spells, and your horn rams harder.
subrace.rpgclasses.centaur.unicorn.name: Unicorn
subrace.rpgclasses.centaur.warrior.desc: At 40% of your top speed or more you attack without slowing down (Epic Fight) and deal more melee damage the faster you go. Ramming slows you down less.
subrace.rpgclasses.centaur.warrior.name: Warrior
subrace.rpgclasses.colossus.porter.desc: You carry a belt of chests, furnaces and tables that you can use while walking (race key 1; allies open it by sneaking and right-clicking you), and your allies can ride on you. Somewhat slower, and more so with passengers.
subrace.rpgclasses.colossus.porter.name: Porter
subrace.rpgclasses.colossus.titan.desc: Grow (racial key 1): you double your size again with a second health bar, break in 3×3×3 and the ground shakes with every step.
subrace.rpgclasses.colossus.titan.name: Titan
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.acid.desc: You resist acid, food never disagrees with you and your breath corrodes the target's armor.
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.acid.name: Acid
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.fire.desc: You resist fire and your breath sets enemies alight. Wild fire dragons do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.fire.name: Fire
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.ice.desc: You resist ice and freezing, and your breath slows. Wild ice dragons do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.ice.name: Ice
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.lightning.de: You resist lightning and your breath's lightning jumps to nearby enemies. Wild lightning dragons do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.poison.desc: You resist toxic damage (immune to Poison from Rank 2) and your breath poisons.
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.poison.name: Venomous
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.water.desc: You resist water and drowning, your air lasts three times as long (you breathe underwater from Rank 2) and your breath pushes and puts out fire.
subrace.rpgclasses.draconid.water.name: Water
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.desc: You see in the dark underground and are immune to Darkness. Stone Sense (racial key 1, Rank 1) highlights nearby ores and lava.
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.name: of the Depths
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.desc: Your own TNT does not hurt you and explodes with a 25% larger radius. From Rank 1, breaking an ore also breaks the connected ones (not while crouching). At Rank 3, crouching, you mine stone in a 3×3 tunnel (uses more hunger).
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.name: Demolisher
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.desc: Things you craft or repair last longer (+20%, +40% at Rank 2). From Rank 1 the anvil costs you half the levels. At Rank 3 things you craft come out with Unbreaking +1 (maximum III).
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.name: Smith
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.desc: The enchanting table counts as if its level were higher and enchanting (table or anvil) costs you less experience. At Rank 3, fuse two identical maximum-level enchantments at the anvil to exceed that maximum by 1.
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.name: Arcane
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.dark.desc: You see in any darkness. Smoke Cloud (racial key 1, Rank 1): you and your allies inside are invisible and mobs outside lose sight of you. It is not revealed by proximity.
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.dark.name: Dark
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.desc: Your crops give more yield; with ranks, plant food fills you more and you can grow crops with an empty hand.
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.name: Sylvan
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.desc: Light Fingers: when hitting in melee you can steal an item from a mob's loot (without killing it) or from a player's inventory (never from the hotbar or the kit).
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.name: Thief
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.desc: Snare (racial key 1): you place a trap that never expires, only you can see it and the first enemy to step on it takes damage and is immobilized.
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.name: Trapper
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.wolf_rider.des: Right-click your wolf with an empty hand to ride it (crouching: make it sit, as usual). With ranks: your wolves have more health, the ridden wolf bites whatever you hit and regenerates while you ride it.
subrace.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.desc: You lose less XP when resetting your class or subclass: the loss is reduced by your Rank's percentage.
subrace.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.name: Autodidact
subrace.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.desc: Choose a second wall, which receives half the reduction.
subrace.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.name: Polyvalent
subrace.rpgclasses.human.specialist.desc: The reduction of your chosen wall is 50% greater (up to −75% at Rank 3).
subrace.rpgclasses.human.specialist.name: Specialist
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.native.desc: Piglins, brutes and hoglins are neutral toward you unless you attack them. With ranks: immune to Wither, better bartering with piglins and Infernal Compass (racial key 1, Rank 3).
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.native.name: Native
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.d: Your racial Fire Shot pierces enemies. With ranks, your racial Magma Bomb leaves a pool of flames and, at Rank 3, lava that slows. Requires Iron's Spells.
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.desc: You walk on lava. With ranks, nearby furnaces run faster, ores you mine come out smelted and you instantly smelt what you hold in hand (racial key 1, Rank 3).
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.name: Smelter
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.desc: You eat raw meat and fish without negative effects and they fill you as if cooked. With ranks, killing feeds you and grants combat effects.
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.name: Devourer
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.desc: Thick Skin: each hit you take deals less damage by a fixed amount, with no minimum.
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.desc: Warlord's Voice (racial key 1): removes control effects from you and nearby allies.
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.name: Warlord
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.mitotic.desc: Even less health, but when an enemy lands a lethal hit you split into two half-size copies. Sneak next to your copy to merge.
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.mitotic.name: Mitotic
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.spring.desc: Sneak to charge a jump; when you jump you are launched where you look (like Riptide), with no impact damage and bouncing off floors and walls.
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.spring.name: Spring
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.swarm.desc: Racial key 1: you split into one small slime per heart (max 25) that only deal contact damage. Each hit kills one slime and the leftover damage does not carry over. Healing while split spawns new slimes. Press again to merge.
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.swarm.name: Swarm
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.viscous.desc: Sneak against a wall or an entity to stick to it. You slide slowly down walls as if on honey and your hits apply Slowness.
subrace.rpgclasses.slime.viscous.name: Viscous
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.desc: Drowned and guardians are neutral toward you unless you attack them. With ranks: underwater immunities, camouflage and a guardian escort.
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.name: Abyssal
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.desc: Fish bite sooner and you have racial Luck of the Sea when fishing; with ranks, extra catches, more treasure and more experience.
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.name: Fisher
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.desc: Tame Water (racial key 1): a temporary water source. Wave (racial key 2, Rank 1): pushes enemies; 2 charges at Rank 3. Water Wall (crouch + racial key 1, Rank 2).
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.name: Shaper
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.desc: Skeletons are neutral toward you unless you attack them and you take less projectile damage. At Rank 3 your regeneration is interrupted for less time.
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.name: Skeleton
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.specter.desc: You take no fall damage and fall slowly (crouching prevents it). Ethereal Form (racial key 1, Rank 1): a few seconds unable to take damage or attack; it does not protect from the sun.
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.specter.name: Specter
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.desc: Thirst: killing heals you and, with ranks, you steal life from the damage you deal (with a per-second cap).
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.name: Vampire
